name: Privatzimmer-Ferienwohnung Geißler
beschreibung: The Geißler Holiday Apartment is located in a quiet spot in the Tiroler Unterland. Thiersee is an ideal starting point for hiking and cycling tours. The apartment is practically furnished and is suitable for self-caterers who want to enjoy the Tiroler Bergwelt in peace. The village is close to Lake Walchsee.
